places-grindon-school-roman-temporary-ca.story: From Haydon Bridge it runs 72 km to Haydon Bridge; allow about 1 h 14 of riding. It goes by way of Sunny Rigg 2 Roman temporary camp, Hadrian's Wall and vallum between Banks Gr and back through Sunny Rigg 2 Roman temporary camp. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Kancamagus Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 14 km this is Kancamagus Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
